title: How Does a Skipper Choose Where to Stop for a Swim in Madeira?
description: By reading the sea that morning: swell and wind direction, shelter, depth, rocks, other boats and the group on board. So the spot can change on the day.
heroAlt: Skipper seen from behind at the helm, slowing the boat into a calm sheltered cove
keywords: how does a skipper choose a swim stop
where do boats stop to swim in Madeira
why did the boat change the swim spot
safe swimming from a boat Madeira
